findings.counterexample_to_confirm_without_real_i: Authored bytes {"x":1e999} and nested/negative variants should refuse JSON_NONFINITE rather than return a structure containing nonfinite float. No example executed in this triage.
findings.evidence: exact_json supplies parse_constant but no parse_float or recursive finite validation. parse_constant handles named NaN/Infinity tokens; ordinary exponent numeric parsing uses the default float conversion.
findings.impact: The shared JSON admission helper has a finite-value validation gap; current project_public checks and later packed(..., allow_nan=False) may still refuse affected projection paths, so no accepted ledger contamination is claimed. Authored existing cases test literal NaN/Infinity only.
findings.requested_fix: Use a finite parse_float conversion or recursively reject nonfinite decoded values, with a bounded mock regression and unchanged input size/depth policy.
findings.title: Nonfinite JSON detection does not cover numeric exponent overflow

findings.counterexample_to_confirm_without_real_i: In an authored fixture, make a permitted store operation raise PermissionError or another non-missing OSError once; have trusted mock callback catch it and then request valid public data. The enclosing operation must fail without COMPLETE, not silently finish. No example executed here.
findings.evidence: ReadView.read routes KeyError/FileNotFoundError and LedgerRefused through budget.trip. Other OSError subclasses from store.size/read escape without marking budget failed. A callback that catches that error can proceed to the next valid read and post-callback budget.check sees no latched refusal.
findings.impact: Current missing-file/hash/path/budget failures are sticky, but general I/O errors are not. This narrows the handoff claim that caught errors remain latched; it is distinct from adversarial sandboxing and from the absent real adapter.
findings.requested_fix: Latch expected storage I/O failure before propagating it, preserving primary error/redaction semantics. Add a finite focused authored regression without reading actual files.
findings.title: Non-missing store I/O errors bypass sticky budget failure
